_comment: The signing fingerprints walnut-watch accepts per suite (field 1 of gpgv's VALIDSIG: the key that made the signature). Installed root-owned into rules/ on the server by deploy.sh --rules at a sitting. 8FFE...: the archive primary key (offline; signs the licensed suite on the dev PC). AC79...: its signing subkey (a GitHub secret; signs stable and releases). C902...: the CI key (testing and nightlies). test_walnut_watch.py checks every one is a signing key of its keyring in apt-repo/keyrings.
